# grok-tools-chat

> Browser chat app composed by grokhack-forge: Grok via Vercel AI SDK @ai-sdk/xai with streaming and local tools (calculator, time, live GitHub repo lookup) plus xAI web search; visitors bring their own key, sent only to api.x.ai.

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Blockchains/grok-tools-chat/main/README.md): overview, install and the 'Use as a building block' section
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Blockchains/grok-tools-chat/main/AGENTS.md): setup, build/test commands, structure map, conventions and rules for AI coding agents
- [blocks.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Blockchains/grok-tools-chat/main/blocks.json): machine-readable building-block manifest (entrypoints, inputs, outputs, deps, compatible blocks)

## Key files

- [src/grok.ts](https://github.com/Blockchains/grok-tools-chat/blob/main/src/grok.ts): `chat()` async generator over streamText, `listModels`, error/credits handling
- [src/tools.ts](https://github.com/Blockchains/grok-tools-chat/blob/main/src/tools.ts): `localTools` (AI SDK `tool()` + zod), the extension point
- [src/main.ts](https://github.com/Blockchains/grok-tools-chat/blob/main/src/main.ts): UI
- [src/forge.config.ts](https://github.com/Blockchains/grok-tools-chat/blob/main/src/forge.config.ts): archetype/model/feature flags
